facts.fact: The document lists "adoption du document de stratégie actualisé" as the last step of its preparation method and records no adoption of the 2016-2020 text; the foreword says the Government "a décidé d'élaborer" the strategy.
facts.system: Politique et stratégies nationales de développement des TIC et de l'économie numérique 2016-2020

facts.fact: The document is the strategy's own full text (three pillars, 17 axes, 89 actions), published by the ministry and hosted as a PDF at smartafrica.org; the day is taken from the file name (version 6, 28 July 2016).
facts.system: Politique et stratégies nationales de développement des TIC et de l'économie numérique 2016-2020

facts.fact: The strategy covers 2016-2020, with a five-year action plan to the 2020 horizon.
facts.system: Politique et stratégies nationales de développement des TIC et de l'économie numérique 2016-2020

facts.fact: The action plan sets activities, deadlines, indicators and responsible bodies, and costs the strategy at GNF 1,500 billion over five years (Tables 12 and 13), with a yearly spending schedule.
facts.system: Politique et stratégies nationales de développement des TIC et de l'économie numérique 2016-2020

facts.fact: The document provides a technical committee drawn from the ministry and a steering committee chaired by the minister, with ministry and stakeholder representatives, to monitor implementation; no date of their creation is given.
